name: Trouble Trap Laboratory
source:
Main character wakes up at a laboratory bed with various sensors attached. Two people analyze the sperm taken and give it a "pass" score. What are the contents of this mad scientist's experiments?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在实验室的床上醒来，身上连接着各种传感器。两个人分析了从他体内采集的精液，并给出“合格”评价。这个疯狂科学家究竟在进行怎样的实验？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
